OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<ViciousPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Vicious.cs:26) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, ViciousPower, self._cards, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (25) and the Vulnerable hover tip (14). THIS CARD IS THE WITNESS FOR THE POOL'S LARGEST GAP FAMILY: `ViciousPower.AfterPowerAmountChanged` fires on any Vulnerable its owner applies with NO liveness test on the target (ViciousPower.cs:19-26; sim port powers.py:1160-1179), which is what makes the `if not target.is_gone` guards on card/bash, card/break, card/fight_me, card/mangle, card/squash, card/taunt, card/tremble, card/uppercut and card/mad_science LIVE rather than dormant. Its own port is faithful.
